name: MBTA Rail Guide
description: Answers questions about the MBTA's subway, light rail and commuter rail from its GTFS feed as a graph: stations, the stops in them, routes and the lines they are on.

tools.name: Which Routes Serve a Station
tools.description: Lists the routes and lines that serve one station, such as Park Street or South Station. Takes a station, not a route.

config.template: MATCH (line:Line)<-[:ON]-(service:Route)-[:SERVES]->(station:Station) WHERE station.name = $stationName WITH service, line ORDER BY service.order RETURN service.name AS route, line.name AS line, service.kind AS kind LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: stationName
parameters.description: The station's name as written in the question.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

tools.name: Stations on a Route in Order
tools.description: Lists every station one route serves, in the order a train reaches them, such as the Red Line or the Fitchburg Line. Takes a route, not a station.

config.template: MATCH (route:Route)-[serves:SERVES]->(station:Station) WHERE route.name = $routeName RETURN serves.sequence + 1 AS position, station.name AS station, station.municipality AS municipality ORDER BY position LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: routeName
parameters.description: The route's name as written in the question.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

tools.name: Subway Journey Between Two Stations
tools.description: Finds up to four ways to get from one place to another by subway and light rail, best first: where to board, the line ridden to each change, any walk at either end, the stops, the changes and a rough time. Takes two places, each a station or a landmark such as the ICA or Fenway Park; a landmark is reached on foot from the stations near it. Use it for any question about getting from one place to another. Commuter rail is left out.

config.template: MATCH (origin:Place), (destination:Place) WHERE origin.name = $fromStation AND destination.name = $toStation CALL { WITH origin MATCH (near:Station)-[leg:CONNECTS]->() WHERE leg.kind <> 'commuter rail' AND point.distance(origin.location, near.location) <= 1200 WITH DISTINCT near, toInteger(point.distance(origin.location, near.location)) AS walk ORDER BY walk LIMIT 3 RETURN collect({station: near, walk: walk}) AS starts } CALL { WITH destination MATCH (near:Station)<-[leg:CONNECTS]-() WHERE leg.kind <> 'commuter rail' AND point.distance(destination.location, near.location) <= 1200 WITH DISTINCT near, toInteger(point.distance(destination.location, near.location)) AS walk ORDER BY walk LIMIT 3 RETURN collect({station: near, walk: walk}) AS ends } UNWIND starts AS start UNWIND ends AS end WITH start, end, starts, ends WHERE start.station <> end.station WITH start.station AS boardAt, end.station AS alightAt, start.walk AS walkToBoard, end.walk AS walkFromAlight, [other IN starts WHERE other.walk < start.walk | other.station] AS nearerStarts, [other IN ends WHERE other.walk < end.walk | other.station] AS nearerEnds MATCH journey = allShortestPaths((boardAt)-[:CONNECTS*..60]->(alightAt)) WHERE all(leg IN relationships(journey) WHERE leg.kind <> 'commuter rail') WITH boardAt, alightAt, walkToBoard, walkFromAlight, nearerStarts, nearerEnds, relationships(journey) AS legs, nodes(journey) AS calls WHERE none(passed IN calls[1..] WHERE passed IN nearerStarts) AND none(passed IN calls[..-1] WHERE passed IN nearerEnds) WITH boardAt, alightAt, walkToBoard, walkFromAlight, size(legs) AS stops, legs, calls, [position IN range(0, size(legs) - 1) WHERE position = size(legs) - 1 OR legs[position].route <> legs[position + 1].route] AS lastLegs WITH boardAt, alightAt, walkToBoard, walkFromAlight, stops, size(lastLegs) - 1 AS changes, [position IN lastLegs | legs[position].line] AS lines, [position IN lastLegs | calls[position + 1].name] AS alightings, [position IN lastLegs | legs[position].routeName] AS routes WITH boardAt, alightAt, walkToBoard, walkFromAlight, stops, changes, lines, alightings, collect(DISTINCT routes) AS variants WITH boardAt, alightAt, walkToBoard, walkFromAlight, stops, min(changes) AS fewestChanges, collect({changes: changes, lines: lines, alightings: alightings, variants: variants}) AS ways UNWIND ways AS way WITH boardAt, alightAt, walkToBoard, walkFromAlight, stops, way WHERE way.changes = fewestChanges WITH boardAt, alightAt, walkToBoard, walkFromAlight, stops, way.changes AS changes, way.lines AS linesRidden, [position IN range(0, size(way.lines) - 1) | CASE WHEN all(variant IN way.variants WHERE variant[position] = way.variants[0][position]) THEN way.variants[0][position] ELSE way.lines[position] END + ' to ' + way.alightings[position]] AS rides WITH *, toInteger(round(stops * 2 + changes * 5 + (walkToBoard + walkFromAlight) / 80.0)) AS aboutMinutes ORDER BY aboutMinutes, changes, stops WITH linesRidden, collect({boardAt: boardAt.name, alightAt: alightAt.name, walkToBoard: walkToBoard, walkFromAlight: walkFromAlight, stops: stops, changes: changes, rides: rides, aboutMinutes: aboutMinutes})[0] AS best ORDER BY best.aboutMinutes, best.changes, best.stops LIMIT $limit RETURN CASE WHEN best.walkToBoard > 0 THEN 'walk ' + best.walkToBoard + ' m to ' + best.boardAt ELSE best.boardAt END AS start, reduce(text = '', ride IN best.rides | text + CASE WHEN text = '' THEN '' ELSE ', then ' END + ride) AS ride, CASE WHEN best.walkFromAlight > 0 THEN 'walk ' + best.walkFromAlight + ' m from ' + best.alightAt ELSE '' END AS finish, best.stops AS stops, best.changes AS changes, best.aboutMinutes AS aboutMinutes

parameters.name: fromStation
parameters.description: The station or landmark the journey starts at.

parameters.name: toStation
parameters.description: The station or landmark the journey ends at.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of ways to return.

tools.name: Stations Near a Station
tools.description: Lists the stations within walking distance of one station, nearest first, with the distance in metres. Takes one station.

config.template: MATCH (centre:Station) WHERE centre.name = $nearStation MATCH (other:Station) WHERE other <> centre AND point.distance(centre.location, other.location) <= $withinMetres RETURN other.name AS station, toInteger(point.distance(centre.location, other.location)) AS metres ORDER BY metres LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: withinMetres
parameters.description: The distance in metres, only if the question gives one.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

tools.name: Platforms in a Station
tools.description: Lists the stops inside one station: each platform, the route that calls at it and whether it is wheelchair accessible. Takes one station.

config.template: MATCH (station:Station)<-[:IN]-(platform:Stop)<-[:CALLS_AT]-(route:Route) WHERE station.name = $platformsOf RETURN DISTINCT platform.platform AS platform, route.name AS route, platform.accessible AS accessible, platform.id AS stopId ORDER BY route, platform LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: platformsOf
parameters.description: The station's name as written in the question.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

tools.name: Stations in a Municipality
tools.description: Lists the stations in one city or town, such as Cambridge or Somerville, with the routes serving each. Takes a municipality.

config.template: MATCH (station:Station)<-[:SERVES]-(route:Route) WHERE station.municipality = $municipalityName RETURN station.name AS station, collect(DISTINCT route.name) AS routes ORDER BY station LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: municipalityName
parameters.description: The city or town as written in the question.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.
